cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 ether/sulfonate chassis - defining anionic Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate @2 with prominent buffers Cocamidopropyl Betaine @4 and Coco-Glucoside @11 and no reinforcing strong anionic. Counter-signals (refatting oils @7-8, glyceryl oleate) recorded; they do not move the convention and no C3b member decides the value.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: C2 met - the prominent payload lipids Coconut Oil @7 and Argan Oil @8 take the place of the early silicone, with prominent cationic polymers (Polyquaternium-10 @13, Polyquaternium-7 @15, Guar HPTC @18), the prominent pearlizing route Glycol Distearate @21 and listed humectants Glycerin @5 / Panthenol @10; Polyimide-1 @12 film former adds a further route. Counter-signal: no silicone, oils sit after Sodium Chloride @6 and the cationics after Panthenol, so each route may be modest; neighbor moderate.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: plausible bounded residue from several converging routes (material oils, three cationic polymers, a film former) against an effective C1 reset; W-RICH holds but reset is not limited, so the rich route does not reach high, and the convergence route is judged not strong enough to outweigh the AOS/betaine/glucoside reset. W-RICH recorded as counter-signal, neighbor high.

Against: the oils sit after Sodium Chloride @6 and all cationics/film former after Panthenol @10, so each route is plausibly small; the AOS @2 + betaine + glucoside C1 chassis is an effective ordinary reset.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Several converging depositing families make noticeable but bounded residue plausible; calling it light would understate it.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: W-RICH needs limited reset (resetCapacity weak) and the C1 AOS chassis is moderate reset; the convergence route rests on individually late/small routes (cationics @13-18, film former @12) that an effective reset plausibly offsets. Not low: four deposition families including material oils and three cationics (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: INCI-only prominence of the oils and cationics; band close to high (W-RICH present).
